overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Commission meets only in its quasi-judicial capacity, which is exempt under G.L. c. 30A, § 18, so it had no open meeting minutes to provide.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Commission failed to make available minutes of its two most recent public meetings after a April 21 request.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Commission has not held any meetings other than those in its quasi­judicial capacity, and because those meetings are exempt from the requirements of the Open Meeting Law, we find that the Commission did not violate the Open Meeting Law by failing to provide Mr. Saklad with meeting minutes.
